finding.title: The ferry arrives before its minimum travel time
finding.summary: A two-hour crossing leaves at 11:30 a.m. but is shown arriving at noon the same day.
finding.question: Can the noon arrival and the stated two-hour crossing both be correct?
finding.conflicting_fact_a: The crossing takes exactly two hours and departs at 11:30 a.m.
finding.conflicting_fact_b: Omar arrives at North Point at noon the same day.
finding.inference_explanation: The exact times leave ninety minutes unaccounted for.

evidence.quote: The crossing takes exactly two hours. Departure is 11:30 a.m.
The clock reads 12:00 p.m. Omar steps off at North Point.
